record.rationale: Adapts LibreOffice FontList device enumeration to the browser Local Font Access API with deterministic metric-compatible fallbacks when access is unavailable.
responsibilities: Enumerates, deduplicates, sorts, and exposes font families available to the active browser environment.

Pinned ICU78.3 property data and original consumed scalar algorithms match compiled original block/script/editing-class observations for every Unicode codepoint. Source BreakIterator script runs retain the initial-NUL cache quirk.
